ModMetadata.Name: Spray Paint Plus
ModMetadata.Author: SixFive7
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Spray Paint Plus[/h1]
Combines [b]color cycling[/b], [b]network painting[/b], [b]glow paint[/b], and [b]infinite spray paint[/b] into one multiplayer-safe Stationeers mod.
Full multiplayer compatibility. Safe to remove from existing savegames.
[h2]Features[/h2]
[h3]Full Multiplayer Support[/h3] Works for host and clients alike; late joiners immediately see the correct spray can colors.
[h3]Color Cycling[/h3] Scroll your mouse wheel while holding a spray can to cycle through all paint colors. No more carrying twelve cans in a backpack. Three modes: cycle every color, cycle only within the can's own paint family, or turn the wheel off so each color needs its own printed can.
[h3]Color Picking (Eyedropper)[/h3] Right-click any paintable object with a spray can in hand to copy its color onto the can. Left-click the next item to match. [list] [*][b]Ctrl+right-click[/b] picks the as-built kit color, ignoring any later repaint [*][b]Shift+right-click[/b] is reserved (currently no-op) [*]Works on any paintable object [/list]
[h3]Infinite Spray Paint[/h3] Spray cans have unlimited uses and produce no pollution. Both are configurable.
[h3]Network Painting[/h3] Spray-paint one piece of a connected network and the whole network gets painted at once. [list] [*][b]Hold Shift[/b] to paint just a single item (or swap this default, see Settings) [*][b]Hold Ctrl[/b] for a checkered/alternating paint pattern [*]Works on pipe networks (hydroponic trays and passive vents paint separately), cable networks, chute networks, robotic arm rail assemblies, and elevators (the carriage is painted separately) [*]Stairs connect every flight of a continuous staircase; stairwells connect every adjacent block, all eight types and any orientation; ladders connect the column, end caps included [/list]
[h3]Room & Structure Painting[/h3] Spray-paint a wall and every same-type wall bounding the same room is painted. Spray-paint a frame, girder, or any other large structure and all orthogonally-connected structures of the same exact type are painted with it. [list] [*]Walls flood by Room membership: paint spills across the room's walls but never past a doorway [*]Large structures flood-fill on a grid using 6-neighbor (cardinal) adjacency only; diagonals are not followed [*]Same Shift / Ctrl modifiers apply [/list]
[h3]Glow Paint[/h3] The [b]Spray Paint Gun[/b] becomes a glow applicator: fire at a painted target to add a glow halo (visible in unlit rooms) while keeping its color. Every paint color supports glow. [list] [*]Gun is ammo-less. It no longer accepts spray cans; its can slot is hidden in the inventory [*]Gun never changes a target's color. To change color, paint with a plain can first, then fire the gun to add glow [*]Shift (single target) and Ctrl (checkered pattern) modifiers apply to gun-paint too [*]Right-click the gun to switch between [b]Add Glow[/b] and [b]Remove Glow[/b] modes (vanilla on/off toggle, HUD label rebranded) [*]Glow state persists across save/load and syncs in multiplayer [*]The "Glow Paint" setting turns the feature off on either side; when off, the gun reverts to vanilla can-accepting behavior. Glow other players applied stays visible to you either way [/list]
[h3]Safe to Uninstall[/h3] Saves written by v1.6.0+ open cleanly without this mod; glow lives in a side-car the vanilla loader ignores.
[h3]Settings[/h3]
[b]Settings come in pairs.[/b] Every capability has a client half and a server half, and it works only when both allow it. Your half decides what you personally do, never what you see; the host's half decides what the world allows at all. Neither half can grant what the other refuses. Single-player and hosting count as the server, so both halves are local and either one can switch a capability off.
Joining a server gives you one console message naming every function you have enabled that the server does not allow, and a message the first three times you actually try to use one. Your own settings are never rewritten; they just have no effect there.
33 settings across nine groups, five client and four server. What they cover: [list] [*][b]Color Cycling[/b]: how the mouse wheel changes a can's color (all colors, only within the can's own paint family, or not at all), and whether the right-click eyedropper works [*][b]Network Painting[/b]: the master toggle plus one entry per kind of network, for pipes, cables, chutes, walls, rails, large structures, elevators, ladders, stairs and stairwells [*][b]Glow Paint[/b]: whether the Spray Paint Gun applies glow, or reverts to the base game gun that loads a spray can [*][b]Consumables[/b]: unlimited spray can uses, plus pollution suppression (server-only, the atmosphere is shared) [*][b]Preferences[/b]: single-item-by-default and inverted scroll direction (client-only, pure input mapping) [/list]
Metallic Paints DLC rules apply on top of every mode; no setting can reach a color the session is not entitled to.
The full 33-entry table with every default is in the [url=https://github.com/SixFive7/StationeersPlus/tree/master/Mods/SprayPaintPlus#settings]README on GitHub[/url].
[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[b]Requires:[/b] [list] [*][url=https://docs.bepinex.dev/]BepInEx[/url] [*][url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] [/list]
[b]Incompatible with[/b] (detected at startup; the mod refuses to load if either is found): [list] [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3163662298]Color Cycler[/url] by Elmotrix [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2876605527]Network Painter[/url] by Elmotrix [/list]
[b]Redundant[/b] (disable if installed): [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3576112002]Infinite Spray Paint[/url] by Aspct, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1761980496]Infinite Paint Mod[/url] by Dingo.
[b]All players[/b] (including dedicated servers) need the same BepInEx + StationeersLaunchPad + Spray Paint Plus setup; matching versions are enforced by the handshake.
[b]Metallic colors in a brand new world:[/b] locked until you save and reload once. Base game behavior, not this mod. Without the mod the game will not spawn or fabricate metallic cans there either.
[h2]Reporting Issues[/h2] Found a bug? Please open an issue on [url=https://github.com/SixFive7/StationeersPlus/issues]GitHub[/url] with the mod name in the title. Steam comment notifications are unreliable, so GitHub is the way to make sure a report is seen.
[h2]Credits[/h2] [list] [*][b]Elmotrix[/b]: Created [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3163662298]Color Cycler[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2876605527]Network Painter[/url]. The core ideas of scroll-to-cycle and paint-entire-networks are theirs. [*][b]SubHobo[/b] (bls220): Contributed the initial multiplayer networking code to Color Cycler via [url=https://github.com/Elmotrix/ColorCyclerMod/pull/1]PR #1[/url]. [*][b]Aspct[/b]: Created [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3576112002]Infinite Spray Paint[/url]. [*][b]Dingo (DingoPD)[/b]: Created the original [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1761980496]Infinite Paint Mod[/url]. [/list]
[url=https://github.com/SixFive7/StationeersPlus/tree/master/Mods/SprayPaintPlus]Source Code on GitHub[/url]

ModMetadata.ChangeLog: v1.11.0: Every setting has a client half and a server half - CHANGE: All settings reset to their defaults on this update. BepInEx identifies a setting by its group plus its name, and nearly every setting moved group, so the stored values are orphaned and the defaults are re-seeded on first launch. Set your preferences once more after updating. The same reset happened at v1.5.0. - NEW: Every capability now has a client setting and a server setting, and works only when both allow it. 33 settings across nine groups, up from 18 across five. Your half decides what you do, never what you see; the host's half decides what the world allows. - NEW: Color Cycling is a dropdown with three modes. Cycles through all colors is the default and matches the old behavior. Cycles within paint family keeps a base-color can on the twelve base colors and a metallic can on the four metallic ones. Can cannot change color turns the wheel off, so each color needs its own printed can. - NEW: Color Picking, the right-click eyedropper, is its own setting instead of riding along with color cycling. - NEW: Joining a server gives you one console message naming every function you have enabled that the server does not allow, and a message the first three times you actually try to use one. Your own settings are never rewritten; they just have no effect there. - CHANGE: The client setting "Enable Metallic Paints" is gone. Cycles within paint family replaces it. - REMOVED: the Extra Paintable Structures setting, because the base game now ships Steel Frame (Corner) and (Side) paintable as of game version 0.2.6332.27293. - CHANGE: Glow Paint already needed both sides to agree, but a mismatch failed silently and read as a bug. It now says so in its descriptions and reports it in-game. - Three settings deliberately have no partner. Paint Single Item By Default and Invert Color Scroll Direction are pure input mapping, where a server has no sensible opinion. Suppress Spray Paint Pollution is server-only, because the atmosphere is shared and one player opting out would change the air for everybody. - Single-player and hosting count as the server: both halves are local, both apply, and either one can switch a capability off. - Metallic Paints DLC rules are unchanged and still apply on top of every mode. No mod setting can reach a color the session is not entitled to. - Thanks to streakymirror73 for asking for a way to switch color cycling off, and to AlienXtream for asking for base and metallic colors to be cycled separately. This release is both. - Multiplayer-safe; no save-format changes. - REQUIRES: All players on a server must run 1.11.0 (matching-version handshake).
ModMetadata.InGameDescription: Spray Paint Plus Combines color cycling, network painting, glow paint, and infinite spray paint into one multiplayer-safe Stationeers mod. Full multiplayer compatibility. Safe to remove from existing savegames. Features: - Scroll wheel cycles can colors: all, one paint family, or off - Right-click a target with a can to copy its color; Ctrl+right-click picks the as-built color - Infinite spray paint, no pollution (both configurable) - One-stroke paint for pipe / cable / chute networks, rooms of same-type walls, connected large structures, robotic arm rail assemblies, elevators, ladder columns, staircases, and stairwell blocks - Spray Paint Gun adds glow to painted targets (ammo-less, keeps color); right-click it to toggle Add Glow / Remove Glow - Shift = single item, Ctrl = checkered pattern - Full multiplayer with matching-version handshake - Safe to uninstall: v1.6.0+ saves open cleanly without this mod Settings: Settings come in pairs, yours and the server's; a function works when both allow it. Requires: BepInEx + StationeersLaunchPad. All players and dedicated servers need the same setup. Incompatible with: Color Cycler, Network Painter (both by Elmotrix). Redundant (disable if installed): Infinite Spray Paint by Aspct, Infinite Paint Mod by Dingo. Credits: Elmotrix, SubHobo (bls220), Aspct, Dingo.
